description: Pro only. Return the terms of up to 10 bonds as read from their offering documents: calls and make-whole, change of control, covenants, events of default, amendment votes, ranking, governing law, payments and coupon terms. Ask for topics or single fields to keep the answer short. Every confirmed value carries its verbatim quote and the document page; other states are not_confirmed, not_found, does_not_apply or not_read, and never mean "no". These are what the documents say; bondterminal_get_bonds gives the terms BondTerminal prices with. When they differ, show both. Quote the page when you state a term. Billing: 5 read units per bond; at most 10 bonds per call; 60 distinct term sheets a day per account.

fields.description: Single terms to return (for example makeWhole, cocPut, governingLaw); with topics, only terms in both.

identifiers.description: Up to 10 bonds. Each: ISIN, CUSIP, ticker or Argentine local ticker (for example AL30 or GD30).

topics.description: Topics to return, in any order; omitted returns every topic.

name: bondterminal_get_terms

current.description: False when a document was added or changed after the terms were read.

page.description: The printed page number, when the document prints one.

programme.description: Set in the base prospectus; the bond's own final terms can change it.

quote.description: The verbatim document wording the value rests on.

reason.description: Why the term does not apply to this bond.

stateLabel.description: Null when confirmed: the value and its citation are the answer.

title: Bond terms
